title: Hover Explain
description: Cmd/Ctrl+hover any symbol for a short AI explanation in the hover. Works with NVIDIA, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama, LM Studio, any OpenAI-compatible API, or Claude Code.

title: SEBOL for Yokogawa CENTUM VP
description: Manual-traceable language support for Yokogawa CENTUM VP SEBOL: syntax, diagnostics, formatting, navigation, signatures, snippets, and workspace indexing.

title: Tiko
description: Language support for the tiko programming language: diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, references, rename, formatting and more. The language server is included. Tiko is a FreeBASIC-compatible language.

title: RulePeek
description: Hover a CSS class in HTML, JSX, TSX, Vue or Svelte to see its CSS rules, with file and line.

title: Evren Kod
description: Zanaat disipliniyle kodlayan, kanıtla doğrulayan otonom VS Code ajanı. Kodlama, planlama ve eğitim modlarıyla mimari analiz, kanıtlı kod değişikliği, test desteği ve yeni başlayanlar için adım adım mentorluk.

title: TypeScript Structure: Refactoring & Test Impact
description: WebStorm-style refactorings, cross-file inspections, structural search and navigation for TypeScript, JavaScript and React, plus test impact analysis. Deterministic, offline, no AI.

title: Aequivor
description: Run Aequivor cloud coding tasks on your repository, follow them and apply their changes.

title: Trails for VS Code
description: Toggle a configurable command in an editor terminal with Ctrl+\. Defaults to Trails.

title: Auto Fix All Open
description: Behebt alle automatisch behebbaren Probleme (inkl. spezieller Markdown-Regeln) in allen geöffneten Dateien, speichert diese direkt ab und bietet eine Rückgängig-Funktion.

title: MIO Project Switcher
description: 从标题栏快速切换最近项目、工作区和文件，支持彩色项目标识、键盘导航与新窗口打开。
